--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Sound feedback + crash recovery
--
-- Bundled into a single table to keep the main chunk under Lua's 200-local cap.
--
-- .play(): hs.sound.getByFile() can return nil (or :play() can throw) if the
--   audio subsystem is busy/contested. Feedback sounds must NEVER abort their
--   caller — an unguarded play() inside stopRecording() used to throw and
--   prevent doFinalTranscription() from being scheduled, hanging the overlay
--   and losing the whole dictation.
--
-- .snapshot()/.clear()/.salvage(): accepted segment text lives only in memory
--   (pipelineResults) until pipelineFinalize() inserts it. If finalization never
--   runs (stop path aborts, insert throws, or Hammerspoon reloads mid-run) that
--   text would be lost. So we snapshot accepted segments to disk as they
--   complete, clear the snapshot once text is safely inserted, and salvage any
--   orphaned snapshot (on next recording start or on reload) into recent
--   dictations so it can be retrieved from the menu bar.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local recovery = { file = WHISPER_TMP .. "/last-session-recovery.txt" }

function recovery.play(path)
    pcall(function()
        local snd = hs.sound.getByFile(path)
        if snd then snd:play() end
    end)
end

function recovery.snapshot()
    local parts = {}
    for n = 1, (pipelineNextSeg - 1) do
        local t = pipelineResults[n]
        if t and t ~= "" then table.insert(parts, t) end
    end
    if #parts == 0 then return end
    local text = table.concat(parts, " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
    local f = io.open(recovery.file, "w")
    if f then f:write(text); f:close() end
end

function recovery.clear()
    os.remove(recovery.file)
end

function recovery.salvage()
    local f = io.open(recovery.file, "r")
    if not f then return end
    local text = f:read("*a"); f:close()
    text = (text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text ~= "" then
        log("recovery: salvaged orphaned session text (" .. #text .. " chars) → recent dictations")
        table.insert(recentDictations, 1, {
            text = text,
            time = os.time(),
            inserted = false,
            app = "[recovered]",
        })
        while #recentDictations > 10 do table.remove(recentDictations) end
        saveRecentDictations()
    end
    os.remove(recovery.file)
end

-- On load: recover any text stranded by a previous crash/freeze/reload.
recovery.salvage()

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Best-effort sound feedback
--
-- hs.sound.getByFile() can return nil (or :play() can throw) if the audio
-- subsystem is busy/contested. These calls are pure feedback, so they must
-- NEVER be able to abort the caller. Previously an unguarded play() inside
-- stopRecording() could throw and prevent doFinalTranscription() from being
-- scheduled — hanging the overlay and losing the entire dictation.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function playSound(path)
    pcall(function()
        local snd = hs.sound.getByFile(path)
        if snd then snd:play() end
    end)
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Crash recovery for streamed transcription
--
-- Accepted segment text lives only in memory (pipelineResults) until
-- pipelineFinalize() inserts it. If finalization never runs — the stop path
-- aborts, an insert error is thrown, or Hammerspoon is reloaded mid-transcription
-- — that text would be lost forever. To make partial dictations survivable we:
--   * snapshot accepted segments to disk as each one completes,
--   * clear the snapshot once the text is safely inserted, and
--   * salvage any orphaned snapshot (on next recording start or on reload) into
--     the recent-dictations list so it can be retrieved from the menu bar.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local RECOVERY_FILE = WHISPER_TMP .. "/last-session-recovery.txt"

local function writeRecoverySnapshot()
    local parts = {}
    for n = 1, (pipelineNextSeg - 1) do
        local t = pipelineResults[n]
        if t and t ~= "" then table.insert(parts, t) end
    end
    if #parts == 0 then return end
    local text = table.concat(parts, " "):gsub("%s+", " ")
    local f = io.open(RECOVERY_FILE, "w")
    if f then f:write(text); f:close() end
end

local function clearRecoverySnapshot()
    os.remove(RECOVERY_FILE)
end

local function salvageOrphanRecovery()
    local f = io.open(RECOVERY_FILE, "r")
    if not f then return end
    local text = f:read("*a"); f:close()
    text = (text or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
    if text ~= "" then
        log("recovery: salvaged orphaned session text (" .. #text .. " chars) → recent dictations")
        table.insert(recentDictations, 1, {
            text = text,
            time = os.time(),
            inserted = false,
            app = "[recovered]",
        })
        while #recentDictations > 10 do table.remove(recentDictations) end
        saveRecentDictations()
    end
    os.remove(RECOVERY_FILE)
end

-- On load: recover any text stranded by a previous crash/freeze/reload.
salvageOrphanRecovery()
